name: Variants (your own version of any tool)
when_to_use: Use when someone wants a tool to work differently for them: make their own version by conversation, keep it with history, share it as one file, adopt others' versions, and promote widely adopted ones to the original with human approval.

how_to_change.note: Stdlib only. A person's version never touches cells/ or anyone else. Adoption counts must stay honest: one voice per account, author excluded. Promotion is prepared by script and merged by a person.
